sessions.title: KubeCraft Content Engine Design
sessions.summary: Stefan worked on designing a content repurposing system for KubeCraft client Mischa van den Burg. The system turns transcripts from YouTube shorts, highlight channel videos, and LinkedIn clips into platform-optimized carousel assets and posts — all flowing through Airtable review → Metricool. Stefan pivoted mid-session toward building a white-labelable tool instead of a per-client Make.com automation. Hermes generated the carousel prompt grounded in KubeCraft.md brand guidelines and two calibrated LinkedIn post scripts based on top-performing post data.

sessions.title: Community Dashboard Data Sync

sessions.title: Community Dashboard Full Build
sessions.summary: Full-stack KubeCraft Community Dashboard built from scratch in one 104-message session. Scaffolded Next.js 14 app with Supabase backend, built all UI views (Dashboard KPIs, Members table, 9-stage Pipeline Kanban, Follow-ups, Payments), ran SQL migration, imported 1,497 real members from Skool CSV, and created admin auth user. The dashboard is a single source of truth for member pipeline, community analytics, payment tracking, and member profiles for the KubeCraft setter team.

sessions.title: Knowledge OS Deep Synthesis

Wrote two major documents to the Commonplacebook vault: 'Online Knowledge OS Realization Plan' (12KB) and 'Knowledge OS Outcome and Bottleneck Extraction' (17KB). Core finding: the bottleneck is not capture — it is raw input → actual understanding → own words → connected ideas → useful behavior. Defined the 6-engine architecture and the first proof target (one YouTube video end-to-end through Processing Studio).

sessions.title: Recall Studio SaaS Build
sessions.summary: Built the Recall Studio (later 'Resource Studio') — a Node.js app at ~/Documents/New project/ that turns YouTube transcripts into structured Recall Packs with visual artifacts. Major reframe mid-session: the product is not a summarizer but a 'Transcript-to-Resource Studio' — turning transcripts into publishable resources (assessments, microsites, guides, infographics). Visual DNA layer added so outputs have an art direction spine before any artifacts are generated. The KubeCraft assessment (kubecraftassessment.netlify.app) was used as the reference output quality standard.
